evals.prompt: Grade the rendered screens in build/outputs/roborazzi/_inspect_*.png
expect: reads every PNG (does not grade from filenames alone)
checks Tier-1 structural integrity first (overflow, truncation, insets, touch targets), then Tier-2 taste
any Tier-1 violation produces overall VERDICT: fail
every violation names the element, the config it appears in, and a concrete fix

evals.prompt: The happy-path render looks great but the font2.0 compact render clips a button label
expect: does not pass on the strength of the happy path
returns fail because a Tier-1 truncation exists in a stress config

evals.prompt: Is this screen shippable? It uses the default purple Material theme and centers every text block
expect: flags untouched default-purple theme and center-everything as mobile AI-slop anti-patterns
reports them as Tier-2 issues with concrete fixes

evals.prompt: A deterministic assertion already checked touch-target sizes; grade the rest
expect: does not re-litigate the mechanical property the assertion already owns
covers what assertions cannot see, plus all of taste

evals.prompt: Grade SongsScreen and fix the issues you find
expect: evaluates but does NOT edit the @Composable, theme, or any source
writes a verdict with precise fixes for the executor lane to apply
